products.name: Community Banking Services
products.description: Provides a wide range of banking services to individuals and businesses, including deposit accounts (checking, savings), business and consumer loans (commercial, real estate, development, mortgage, home equity, installment), and related services through physical branches, ATMs, and digital platforms.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers a comprehensive range of wealth management and brokerage services, primarily through third-party providers at bank branch locations, requiring licensed professionals and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Provides insurance products to customers through ownership interests in an independent insurance agency, delivered via licensed agents and regulated channels.

products.name: Title and Settlement Services
products.description: Offers full-service title and settlement agency services, including title insurance and closing services, through a dedicated subsidiary, requiring licensed professionals and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Provides residential mortgage loan origination services, including conventional, FHA, USDA, and VA loans, primarily for sale to investors in the secondary mortgage market, through a network of offices and digital channels.

products.name: Mortgage Loan Origination Services for Third Parties
products.description: Provides outsourced mortgage loan origination functions and ancillary production services, such as residential appraisals, to third-party mortgage lenders and community banks, leveraging specialized staff and digital processes.

products.name: Consumer Automobile Financing
products.description: Purchases and services automobile retail installment sales contracts from franchised and independent dealerships, providing indirect auto loans to customers in both prime and non-prime markets, requiring credit underwriting and risk management.

products.name: Marine and Recreational Vehicle (RV) Financing
products.description: Provides indirect financing for marine and recreational vehicle purchases through dealer referral programs, primarily for prime borrowers, though this portfolio is being phased out.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive investment management across asset classes including equities, fixed income, multi-asset, alternatives, digital assets, currencies, commodities, and cash management, delivered via mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts, collective trusts, and other pooled vehicles. Requires global human capital, regulated infrastructure, and proprietary research and analytics.

products.name: Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) – iShares
products.description: Index-tracking and active ETFs providing exposure to equities, fixed income, digital assets, commodities, and multi-asset strategies, traded on exchanges globally. Requires regulated fund structures, portfolio management, and trading infrastructure.

products.name: Private Markets Solutions
products.description: Private markets investment products including infrastructure, private credit, private equity, real estate, and multi-alternative solutions, delivered via funds and bespoke mandates. Involves sourcing, structuring, and managing illiquid assets, requiring specialized expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Liquid Alternatives
products.description: Liquid alternative investment products such as direct hedge funds and hedge fund solutions (funds of funds), providing diversified, actively managed exposure to alternative strategies with daily or periodic liquidity. Requires advanced portfolio management and risk analytics.

products.name: Cash Management Solutions
products.description: Cash management products including taxable and tax-exempt money market funds, short-term investment funds, tokenized liquidity offerings, and customized separate accounts, denominated in multiple currencies. Requires regulated fund structures, liquidity management, and risk controls.

products.name: Digital Assets Investment Products
products.description: Investment products providing exposure to digital assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum via ETPs listed in multiple jurisdictions. Requires digital asset custody, regulatory compliance, and specialized trading infrastructure.

products.name: Currency and Commodity Investment Products
products.description: Investment products providing exposure to currencies and commodities, primarily through ETFs and ETPs, including gold and other commodity funds. Requires specialized portfolio management and trading infrastructure.

products.name: Multi-Asset Investment Solutions
products.description: Multi-asset funds and bespoke mandates combining equities, fixed income, private markets, and tactical overlays, including target date/risk, asset allocation, balanced, and fiduciary management services. Delivered via funds and customized mandates, requiring advanced portfolio construction and risk management.

products.name: Investment Management Technology and Data Solutions (Aladdin, eFront, Preqin, Cachematrix)
products.description: Technology platforms and subscription services for investment and risk management, portfolio construction, private markets data, and cash management, including Aladdin, Aladdin Wealth, eFront, Preqin, and Cachematrix. Delivered as SaaS or enterprise software, requiring ongoing development, support, and integration with client systems.

products.name: Advisory and Outsourcing Services
products.description: Advisory services and whole portfolio outsourcing solutions for institutional and wealth management clients, including fiduciary management and customized investment advice. Delivered through in-person expertise, proprietary analytics, and tailored mandates.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Real Estate Development and Leasing
products.description: Development, leasing, and sale of commercial, industrial, and retail properties, primarily at the Tejon Ranch Commerce Center (TRCC), including distribution centers, retail outlets, and land parcels. Involves physical construction, infrastructure investment, and ongoing property management.

products.name: Multifamily Residential Rental Communities
products.description: Development, leasing, and long-term ownership of multifamily apartment communities, beginning with Terra Vista at Tejon. Involves physical construction, property management, and recurring rental income.

products.name: Master-Planned Resort and Residential Community Development
products.description: Planning, entitlement, and future development of large-scale, mixed-use master-planned communities (Mountain Village, Grapevine, Centennial), including residential housing, commercial, hospitality, and recreational amenities. Involves land entitlement, infrastructure, and long-term construction projects.

products.name: Mineral Resources Leasing and Royalties
products.description: Leasing of land for third-party extraction of oil, gas, rock, aggregate, and cement manufacturing, generating royalty income. Involves contractual arrangements with operators and minimal company capital deployment.

products.name: Farming Operations (Permanent Crops)
products.description: Cultivation and sale of permanent crops including almonds, pistachios, and wine grapes on company-owned acreage. Involves agricultural production, land management, and commodity sales to commercial buyers.

products.name: Ranch Operations (Grazing, Game Management, and Ancillary Land Uses)
products.description: Leasing of land for cattle grazing, guided hunting services, and ancillary uses such as filming. Involves land management, stewardship, and provision of access for external customers.

products.name: Water Sales and Water Asset Management
products.description: Sale of water to third parties (e.g., power plant lessees), management and storage of water assets, and related infrastructure. Involves contractual water sales and operation of water systems.

products.name: Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) and Inspection Services
products.description: Comprehensive field and laboratory-based inspection services using traditional and advanced NDT techniques, including robotics and unmanned systems, to assess asset integrity without disrupting operations. Delivered primarily at customer facilities and through a network of certified laboratories.

products.name: Asset Integrity Management Software and Data Analytical Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based and on-premises software platforms (e.g., OneSuite, PCMS) for centralized management, visualization, and analysis of asset integrity data, supporting compliance, predictive analytics, and maintenance planning. Delivered as software licenses, subscriptions, and managed data services.

products.name: Pipeline Integrity and Inline Inspection Services
products.description: Specialized inspection and data management services for pipelines, including inline inspection (ILI), risk analytics, and compliance documentation, supported by proprietary software and hardware. Delivered through field services and digital platforms.

products.name: Condition Monitoring and Sensing Solutions
products.description: Real-time, online monitoring solutions using permanently-mounted sensors and IoT-connected devices to track asset health, detect damage, and provide early warnings, often in hazardous or hard-to-reach environments. Delivered as installed systems and ongoing monitoring services.

products.name: Laboratory Testing and Quality Assurance Services
products.description: In-house laboratory services for quality assurance and control of metal, alloy, and composite components, including non-destructive and destructive testing, metallurgical analysis, chemical analysis, machining, and finishing. Delivered through certified labs with industry accreditations.

products.name: Mechanical and Maintenance Services
products.description: Complementary maintenance and light mechanical services such as corrosion removal, insulation installation/removal, heat tracing, industrial cleaning, pipefitting, and welding, often integrated with inspection activities. Delivered by multi-disciplined technicians at customer sites, including hard-to-access areas.

products.name: Engineering Consulting and Asset Integrity Management Services
products.description: Engineering consulting for process equipment and facilities, including plant operations support, turnaround planning, process safety reviews, energy optimization, and development of mechanical integrity programs. Delivered by engineering teams as standalone or integrated services.

products.name: Access Solutions (Rope Access, Scaffolding, Diving, Unmanned Systems)
products.description: Specialized access services for inspection and maintenance in at-height, confined, or subsea locations, utilizing rope access, scaffolding, certified divers, and unmanned (drone) systems. Delivered as part of integrated inspection and maintenance projects.

products.name: NDT Equipment and Monitoring Products
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of portable, handheld, wireless, and turnkey NDT equipment, sensors, and monitoring systems, including acoustic emission and ultrasonic testing devices. Delivered as standalone products or integrated service-and-system packages.

products.name: Hospital Inpatient Services
products.description: Provision of general and specialized acute care services, including emergency room, surgery, critical care, internal medicine, obstetrics, psychiatric, and rehabilitation, delivered through owned or leased hospitals with licensed beds and staffed by physicians and healthcare practitioners.

products.name: Outpatient Services
products.description: Delivery of healthcare services outside of inpatient hospital stays, including urgent care, freestanding emergency departments, ambulatory surgery, imaging and diagnostic centers, cancer centers, and occupational medicine clinics, provided at over 1,000 sites of care.

products.name: Physician Practice Services
products.description: Operation and management of physician practices, including both primary care and specialty practices, employing or affiliating with physicians to provide direct patient care in community-based settings.

products.name: Virtual Healthcare Services
products.description: Provision of remote healthcare services, including direct-to-consumer virtual visits and remote patient monitoring, delivered via digital platforms and telehealth technology.

products.name: Live Broadcast Production Services for Cricket Events
products.description: End-to-end live broadcast production for cricket events, including pre-event planning, live camera operations with advanced technology (e.g., Hawk-Eye DRS, super slow-motion, spider cam, drone), technical staffing, satellite uplink, and post-production. Delivered via on-site human labor and regulated broadcast infrastructure.

products.name: Cricket League Franchise Rights and Management
products.description: Sale and management of franchise rights for professional cricket leagues, including team ownership, naming rights, merchandising, local sponsorship, and stadium activation. Delivered through contractual agreements and ongoing operational support.

products.name: Sponsorship Sales and Brand Activation
products.description: Sponsorship sales for cricket leagues and events, providing brand visibility through on-field signage, jersey placements, digital promotions, and in-venue activations. Delivered via negotiated agreements and event execution.

products.name: Broadcast and Streaming Rights Licensing
products.description: Licensing of television, radio, digital, and streaming rights for live cricket content to third-party broadcasters and digital platforms. Delivered through exclusive contractual arrangements and digital content distribution.

products.name: Betting Data Rights Licensing
products.description: Licensing of exclusive rights to collect and distribute real-time match data for betting purposes, including live ball-by-ball statistical feeds. Delivered digitally to betting operators, subject to regulatory compliance.

products.name: Ticketing and On-Ground Sales
products.description: Sale of match tickets and on-ground products/services at cricket events, including box catering and venue-based sales. Delivered through physical ticketing infrastructure and event-day operations.

products.name: International Cricket League Management and Commercialization
products.description: Management and commercialization of cricket leagues in multiple countries (e.g., Singapore, Malaysia, Zimbabwe, Kuwait), including league operations, broadcasting, sponsorship, and franchise sales. Delivered via long-term exclusive rights and operational execution.

products.name: Broadcast Television Networks and Stations
products.description: Operation of domestic and international broadcast television networks and owned stations, delivering entertainment, news, sports, and public affairs programming via regulated broadcast infrastructure and digital platforms.

products.name: Cable Television Networks
products.description: Provision of premium and basic cable channels, including entertainment, music, comedy, kids, and multicultural content, distributed via cable and satellite operators and digital platforms.

products.name: Content Production and Licensing
products.description: Production and global licensing of original series, films, and syndicated programming for broadcast, cable, streaming, and third-party platforms, leveraging in-house studios and intellectual property.

products.name: Direct-to-Consumer Streaming Services
products.description: Operation of subscription and ad-supported streaming platforms (Paramount+, Pluto TV, BET+) offering on-demand and live content, including sports, news, movies, and original series, delivered digitally to global audiences.

products.name: Theatrical Film Production and Distribution
products.description: Production, acquisition, and global distribution of films for theatrical release, home entertainment, and licensing, utilizing in-house studios and partnerships with third parties.

products.name: Home Entertainment Distribution
products.description: Distribution of films and television content via digital and physical formats (DVD, Blu-ray) worldwide, through licensees and direct channels.

products.name: Interactive/Games and Sports Content
products.description: Development and distribution of interactive entertainment, games, and sports content through Skydance’s divisions, delivered digitally and via media platforms.

products.name: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Platform (PortalGuard and PortalGuard IDaaS)
products.description: A cloud-based and on-premise IAM platform providing secure access management, multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and self-service password reset for enterprise, education, and government customers. Delivered as SaaS or on-premise software, it integrates with existing directories and applications, and supports biometric authentication.

products.name: Biometric Authentication Software and APIs (WEB-key, VST, MobileAuth)
products.description: Biometric authentication platforms and APIs enabling fingerprint, palm, facial, and voice biometrics for secure user identification and access. Delivered as cloud or on-premise software, these solutions are used in large-scale civil ID projects, enterprise security, and can be embedded by developers into third-party applications.

products.name: Fingerprint Scanners and Biometric Hardware
products.description: A line of compact, high-quality, low-cost fingerprint scanners and FIDO-compliant hardware devices for biometric authentication. These are physically manufactured devices sold to enterprises and consumers for secure access to computers and applications, including Windows Hello for Business.

products.name: Large-Scale Biometric ID Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Integrated biometric identity infrastructure for government and large-scale identification projects such as voter registration, driver’s licenses, national ID programs, and SIM card registration. Delivered as scalable, cloud-ready platforms supporting regulatory compliance and high-integrity trust requirements.

products.name: FIDO-Compliant Security Keys
products.description: FIDO 2.0 compliant hardware security keys for passwordless authentication, providing an alternative to other hardware tokens. These are manufactured devices sold to organizations requiring strong authentication for users.

products.name: Suspended Mineral Fiber and Fiberglass Ceiling Systems
products.description: Manufactured ceiling systems made from mineral fiber and fiberglass, offering acoustical control, fire protection, energy efficiency, and aesthetic features. Delivered through physical manufacturing and distributed to commercial and residential markets.

products.name: Ceiling Suspension System (Grid) Products
products.description: Manufactured metal grid systems and ceiling components (including perimeters and trim) that support ceiling tiles and drywall ceiling systems, produced via joint venture and sold to distributors and contractors.

products.name: Architectural Specialties (Specialty Ceilings, Walls, and Exterior Metal Solutions)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sources specialty ceilings, walls, and exterior architectural applications using materials such as metal, felt, resin, glass, wood, and gypsum. Products are project-driven, often customized, and delivered through both in-house production and third-party sourcing.

products.name: Prefabricated Ceiling Cloud Systems and Modular Grid Platforms
products.description: Prefabricated ceiling cloud systems and modular grid platforms, including engineering design services, aimed at reducing waste and inefficiencies in building construction. Delivered as physical prefabricated products and associated services.

products.name: Energy Saving Products for Building and Roofing Installations
products.description: Manufactures and develops energy-saving products for building and roofing applications, including innovative ceiling tiles designed to improve energy efficiency. Delivered through physical manufacturing and installation in construction projects.

products.name: Primary Flood Insurance
products.description: Digital-first insurance policies for residential and commercial properties covering primary flood risk, underwritten and administered via proprietary AI/ML platforms and distributed through agencies and direct channels. Policies are structured around the NFIP form and can supplement or replace NFIP coverage.

products.name: Excess Flood Insurance
products.description: Supplemental flood insurance for residential and commercial properties, providing coverage above NFIP or other primary flood policies, delivered digitally and underwritten using proprietary AI/ML technology.

products.name: Parametric Earthquake Insurance
products.description: Insurance product providing predetermined payouts based on earthquake intensity, enabling fast, automated claims processing; delivered digitally and underwritten using proprietary technology, initially launched after acquiring Jumpstart.

products.name: Indemnity Earthquake Insurance (Beta)
products.description: Traditional indemnity-based earthquake insurance, currently in beta for select agencies in California, providing benefits based on actual losses from earthquake events; underwritten and administered via Neptune's digital platform.

products.name: Satellite Communications Products and Services
products.description: Provision and global distribution of satellite-enabled communication equipment (such as satellite phones, broadband terminals, tracking devices, and emergency locator beacons) and related connectivity services (airtime subscriptions, messaging plans, IoT/M2M connectivity) via proprietary e-commerce platforms and third-party marketplaces. Requires physical manufacturing, inventory management, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Mapping and Tracking Portal (GTCTrack)
products.description: Subscription-based, cloud-hosted mapping and tracking platform providing real-time asset location, movement history, and data visualization for customers using tracking devices. Delivered digitally as a SaaS platform with monthly fees.

products.name: Vitamins and Nutritional Supplements
products.description: Sourcing and sale of vitamins and nutritional supplements through Florida Sunshine Brands, distributed via e-commerce channels. Involves physical product sourcing and online retail distribution.

products.name: Retail and Specialty Pharmacy Services
products.description: Operation of full-service retail and specialty pharmacies providing prescription pharmaceuticals, compounded medications, anti-retroviral and specialty medications, and medication therapy management. Delivered through physical pharmacy locations and includes same-day/next-day home delivery, insurance processing, and compliance packaging.

products.name: Long-Term Care Pharmacy Services
products.description: Provision of prescription and non-prescription pharmaceutical products, special packaging, dispensing, and consultant pharmacist services to long-term care facilities. Utilizes unit-of-dose packaging and robotic systems, delivered through physical and mail-based channels.

products.name: 340B Contracted Pharmacy Services
products.description: Contracted pharmacy services for 340B covered entities under the 340B Drug Discount Pricing Program, acting as a pass-through for reimbursements and dispensing medications for covered entities. Involves regulatory compliance and specialized billing.

products.name: Medication Fulfillment Services for Government Facilities
products.description: Provision and fulfillment of prescription and non-prescription medications for contracted government facilities, including medication delivery and regulatory-compliant dispensing.

products.name: Healthcare Data Management and Analytics Services
products.description: Provision of healthcare data management, analytics, and reporting services to healthcare organizations and providers, including pharmacy data analytics, risk management, and support for quality measures. Delivered digitally via proprietary platforms such as 340MetrX and ClearMetrX.

products.name: Virtual Healthcare Services (Telehealth)
products.description: Provision of virtual healthcare services, including telehealth consultations, care management, diagnosis, and self-management support using digital communication technologies. Delivered via web-based and cloud-based platforms.

products.name: Solid-State Lithium-Metal Battery Cells
products.description: Proprietary solid-state lithium-metal battery cells designed for automotive electric vehicles and other applications, manufactured using a ceramic solid-state electrolyte-separator and anode-free architecture to deliver high energy density, fast charging, and enhanced safety. Delivered as multilayer cells, these are produced at pilot and future commercial scale facilities and supplied to OEMs for integration into vehicles and other systems.

products.name: Licensing of Solid-State Battery Technology
products.description: Licensing proprietary solid-state lithium-metal battery technology, including the QSE-5 cell platform and manufacturing processes, to third-party manufacturers and partners (such as PowerCo/Volkswagen) for production and commercialization in automotive and other markets. This includes technology transfer, support, and royalty-based business models.

products.name: Solid-State Electrolyte-Separators
products.description: Manufacture and supply of proprietary solid-state ceramic electrolyte-separator films, which are a core enabling component for lithium-metal batteries, designed for integration into battery cells by OEMs or partners. These separators are produced using scalable, proprietary processes and may be sold as standalone components or as part of technology transfer agreements.

products.name: Rental Apartment Properties
products.description: Ownership, development, and management of high-quality multifamily rental apartment communities in major U.S. metro areas. Properties are physically constructed, maintained, and operated by in-house and third-party teams, with leasing and resident services delivered both in-person and digitally.

products.name: Netskope One Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-native platform integrating security, networking, analytics, and AI security products, delivered via a global private cloud network. It provides real-time contextual intelligence, granular policy enforcement, and seamless digital experience for enterprises, leveraging proprietary AI models and a global edge infrastructure.

products.name: Cloud Inline Security
products.description: Real-time inline data protection and threat defense for cloud and SaaS traffic, inspecting and securing traffic from users, devices, IoT/OT, applications, and AI to cloud services, delivered via the cloud.

products.name: Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
products.description: Provides adaptive visibility and security controls for cloud and SaaS applications in an out-of-band manner, including access control, threat and data protection, and integration with real-time preventive controls.

products.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
products.description: Comprehensive DLP solution that discovers and secures sensitive data across web, cloud, AI, private applications, networks, email, endpoints, users, and devices, using inline, endpoint, email, and non-web modules.

products.name: Threat Protection
products.description: Multi-engine threat detection and blocking for advanced malware, phishing, and other threats, using anti-malware, intrusion prevention, sandboxing, machine learning, and curated threat intelligence, delivered as a cloud service.

products.name: Next-Gen Secure Web Gateway (SWG)
products.description: A cloud-delivered web gateway that provides high-performance TLS decryption, web filtering, malware prevention, and data protection for users and devices, integrating cloud inline security and threat protection in a single-pass architecture.

products.name: Private Access / Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
products.description: Cloud-based remote access solution replacing legacy VPNs, providing secure, adaptive access to private applications based on zero trust principles, leveraging identity, risk, and context scoring.

products.name: Remote Browser Isolation (RBI)
products.description: Cloud-based service that isolates risky and uncategorized websites by rendering web pages in a secure container and presenting safe images to end-users, protecting devices from malicious code.

products.name: SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM)
products.description: Continuous monitoring and hardening of SaaS applications by removing risky integrations, implementing security settings, and reducing misconfiguration-related risks, delivered as a cloud service.

products.name: Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
products.description: Automates data security and governance by discovering, classifying, and monitoring data usage and access governance for structured, unstructured, and semi-structured data across cloud and on-premises environments.

products.name: Enterprise Browser
products.description: A secure browser solution for unmanaged devices and extended enterprise, integrating with the Netskope One platform to provide secure access to web, applications, and AI, and prevent data leakage.

products.name: Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS)
products.description: Cloud-delivered firewall service for egress traffic, providing inspection and protection from layer 3-7 for all ports and protocols, integrated with threat and data protection and DNS security.

products.name: IoT/OT Intelligence
products.description: Provides visibility, classification, risk assessment, segmentation, and access control for IoT and OT devices across enterprise networks, enhancing security for connected devices.

products.name: Software-Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN)
products.description: Secure, reliable connectivity for branches, cloud, remote users, and IoT/OT devices, delivering consistent performance and unified policy enforcement, available as physical, virtual, cloud, or client form factors.

products.name: DNS-as-a-Service (DNSaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based DNS resolution and content filtering service, enabling organizations to protect users with DNS filtering based on business categories and security policies.

products.name: Advanced Analytics
products.description: Provides custom queries, visualizations, and dashboards for Netskope-generated data, offering insights into user activity, data movement, security events, and performance metrics across digital environments.

products.name: User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA)
products.description: Detects insider threats by analyzing user and entity behaviors across web, cloud, SaaS, AI, endpoints, and data stores, using AI/ML and statistical analysis to spot anomalies and assign dynamic trust scores.

products.name: Digital Experience Management (DEM)
products.description: Provides visibility into performance metrics and tools to detect, troubleshoot, and address sources of performance degradation for users and devices across networks and applications.

products.name: AI Security Suite (AI Gateway, Agentic Broker, AI Guardrails, AI Red Teaming)
products.description: Suite of AI security products providing visibility, access, runtime control, content moderation, and adversarial testing for AI and LLM deployments, enabling safe adoption and governance of AI technologies.

products.name: Property Catastrophe Reinsurance
products.description: Provides protection to insurers for large losses from single catastrophic events, typically on a treaty excess of loss basis. Delivered through underwriting teams globally and may involve alternative capital structures via Aspen Capital Markets.

products.name: Other Property Reinsurance
products.description: Covers property risks on excess of loss, proportional treaties, and facultative or single risk reinsurance. Involves close client relationships and regular audits, delivered by underwriting teams in multiple regions.

products.name: Casualty Reinsurance
products.description: Provides reinsurance for casualty risks such as workers’ compensation, medical malpractice, general liability, auto liability, and professional liability, written on excess of loss, proportional, and facultative bases. Delivered by global underwriting teams.

products.name: Specialty Reinsurance
products.description: Offers reinsurance for specialty lines including credit and surety, agriculture, mortgage, marine, aviation, terrorism, engineering, cyber, and other specialty risks. Written on excess of loss and proportional bases by global teams.

products.name: Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: Provides direct insurance for commercial property, commercial liability, primary and excess casualty, environmental liability, and railroad liability. Written on primary, excess, quota share, program, and facultative bases, mainly in the US and UK.

products.name: Marine, Aviation and Energy Insurance
products.description: Provides insurance for marine and energy liability, onshore and offshore energy physical damage, marine hull, specie, and inland and ocean marine risks. Written on primary, excess, quota share, program, and facultative bases, mainly in the UK and US.

products.name: Financial and Professional Lines Insurance
products.description: Covers financial institutions, professional liability, management liability, credit and political risks, crisis management, accident and health, surety, and technology liability (cyber risks). Written globally on primary, excess, quota share, program, and facultative bases.

products.name: Alternative Capital Management (Aspen Capital Markets)
products.description: Manages alternative reinsurance structures and insurance-linked securities (ILS) funds, providing investors direct access to underwriting expertise and earning management and performance fees. Delivered through Aspen Capital Markets.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Royalties
products.description: The Trust owns a Net Profits Interest entitling it to receive 80% of the net profits from the sale of oil and natural gas produced from the Underlying Properties in the Permian Basin. The Trust does not operate or manage the properties but passively receives income from production sold by operators to third-party purchasers. Distribution to unitholders is made monthly based on these receipts.

products.name: Men's Wellness Compounded Products
products.description: A suite of prescription-only, pharmacist-compounded rapid dissolve tablets (RDTs) for men's health, including erectile dysfunction (Mango ED), hair loss (Grow), hormone balance/testosterone enhancement (Mojo), and weight management (Slim). Products are produced at a licensed compounding pharmacy and delivered via telehealth consultations and online fulfillment.

products.name: Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT) Product (PRIME by MangoRx, powered by Kyzatrex®)
products.description: An FDA-approved oral testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) softgel capsule, available by prescription, marketed and sold via the company's telehealth platform and fulfilled through a licensed pharmacy. Delivered to adult men with low or no testosterone levels, offering an alternative to injectable TRT.

products.name: Telehealth Consultation Services for Men's Wellness
products.description: Digital telemedicine services connecting consumers to licensed healthcare professionals for online consultations, prescription evaluation, and ongoing management of men's wellness treatments. Delivered via a proprietary online platform integrating medical providers and pharmacy fulfillment.

products.name: Plant-Based Skin Brightening and Hyperpigmentation Products (Dermytol®)
products.description: Plant-based topical formulations targeting hyperpigmentation, dark spots, uneven skin tone, and skin brightening, marketed under the Dermytol® brand. Products are to be marketed and distributed under a licensing agreement, with commercialization planned for the near future.

products.name: Respiratory Illness Prevention Products (Antiviral Oral Care)
products.description: Products based on patented technology for prevention of respiratory illnesses, including antiviral toothpaste, lozenges, mouthwash, oral sprays, and animal feed/water additives. Commercialization and distribution are licensed to a third party, with ongoing clinical trials and future monetization planned.

products.name: Vafseo (vadadustat)
products.description: An orally administered small molecule HIF-PH inhibitor for the treatment of anemia due to chronic kidney disease (CKD) in adult patients on dialysis. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and formulated into tablets, distributed through third-party logistics and supply agreements with dialysis organizations.

products.name: Auryxia (ferric citrate)
products.description: An orally administered small molecule phosphate binder and iron supplement, approved for control of serum phosphorus in dialysis-dependent CKD and treatment of iron deficiency anemia in non-dialysis-dependent CKD. Manufactured as compressed tablets and distributed via third-party logistics to dialysis organizations and pharmacies.

products.name: Rare Kidney Disease Therapeutics (Pipeline: Praliciguat, AKB-097)
products.description: Investigational oral and biologic therapeutics in mid-stage clinical development for rare kidney diseases such as FSGS, IgA Nephropathy, C3 Glomerulopathy, and Lupus Nephritis. Includes praliciguat (oral sGC stimulator) and AKB-097 (anti-C3d-Factor H fusion protein complement inhibitor), produced via chemical synthesis or recombinant protein technology.

products.name: Early-Stage HIF-Based Therapeutics (Pipeline: AKB-9090, AKB-10108)
products.description: Preclinical and early clinical stage HIF-based small molecule therapeutics being developed for acute kidney injury, acute respiratory distress syndrome, and retinopathy of prematurity. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and intended for oral administration.

products.name: High-Performance Computing (HPC) Data Center Hosting
products.description: Provision of large-scale, compute-optimized data center capacity for high-performance computing workloads, including AI, machine learning, and advanced cloud applications, delivered through long-term hosting and lease arrangements to hyperscale and enterprise customers. Facilities are physically constructed, owned, and operated by the company, with modular, phased expansion and advanced cooling and power infrastructure.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining Operations
products.description: Operation of specialized bitcoin mining facilities using proprietary and third-party hardware to validate transactions on the bitcoin network and earn bitcoin rewards. This involves physical deployment and management of mining computers at company-owned data centers.

products.name: Specialty Rental Accommodations and Hospitality Services
products.description: Turnkey rental of modular accommodation units and integrated hospitality services (including culinary, housekeeping, security, recreation, and facilities management) for workforce populations in remote or infrastructure-limited locations. Delivered via company-owned or managed communities, requiring physical assets, in-person labor, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Construction and Development of Workforce Housing Communities
products.description: Design, construction, and development of modular workforce housing communities for customers, including site planning and rapid deployment of scalable facilities. Delivered as a service, often with the company constructing and sometimes operating the facilities, requiring capital investment, construction expertise, and project management.

products.name: Facilities Management Services for Third-Party-Owned Sites
products.description: Provision of hospitality, culinary, catering, housekeeping, maintenance, and site management services at accommodation facilities owned by other companies. Delivered through in-person labor and operational expertise, without owning the underlying real estate or modular assets.

products.name: Government-Focused Residential and Support Services
products.description: Operation, leasing, and management of residential centers and support communities for government and nonprofit partners, including immigration processing centers and aid facilities. Services include accommodation, catering, janitorial, security, and facility management, delivered under government contracts and requiring compliance with regulatory standards.

products.name: Indirect Tax Compliance Software Platform
products.description: A cloud-based software platform that automates and governs transaction-based compliance obligations for indirect taxes (sales tax, use tax, VAT, etc.) across global jurisdictions. Delivered digitally, it integrates with enterprise systems and is updated monthly with new tax rules.

products.name: Tax Determination Solutions
products.description: Real-time tax calculation and determination engine for indirect taxes and transaction-based fees, using proprietary rules-based logic and content database. Delivered as software integrated into customer workflows and business applications.

products.name: Compliance and Reporting Solutions
products.description: Software solutions that automate the preparation, filing, and remittance of indirect tax returns and compliance reports, supporting e-filing, print formats, and archiving across multiple jurisdictions. Delivered digitally and integrated with customer systems.

products.name: E-invoicing and Digital Compliance Solutions
products.description: A global software solution for compliant electronic invoicing and digital transaction reporting, supporting the end-to-end lifecycle of e-invoices, integration with ERP/financial systems, and compliance with jurisdictional mandates. Delivered digitally and updated for regulatory changes.

products.name: Document Management Solutions
products.description: Software that automates validation, storage, and audit support for sales tax exemption and reseller certificates, enabling enterprises to manage large volumes of compliance documents. Delivered digitally as part of the platform.

products.name: Tax Data Management and Analytics Solutions
products.description: Tools for unifying, analyzing, and managing transaction-level tax data, providing analytics and insights to optimize tax processes and improve compliance. Delivered digitally as part of the software platform.

products.name: Industry-Specific Tax Solutions
products.description: Specialized software solutions tailored for industries with unique indirect tax needs (e.g., retail, communications, leasing), including pre-built integrations and support for industry-specific transactions and compliance requirements.

products.name: Technology Ecosystem Integration Tools
products.description: Pre-built integrations and technology-specific tools (e.g., Chain Flow Accelerator, SAP-specific tools) that enable seamless connection of Vertex solutions with major ERP, eCommerce, and business applications. Delivered as software modules or connectors.

products.name: Implementation Services
products.description: Professional services for configuring, migrating data, implementing, and supporting Vertex software solutions at customer deployment. Delivered by in-person or remote human labor.

products.name: Managed Indirect Tax Compliance Services
products.description: Outsourced managed services for indirect tax return preparation, filing, payment, and notice management, primarily for U.S. and Canadian compliance. Delivered by Vertex staff as a service.

products.name: Ammonia
products.description: Anhydrous ammonia produced via the Haber-Bosch process, sold as a commodity chemical for use in fertilizer, industrial applications, and as a feedstock for upgraded products. Manufactured at large-scale, regulated facilities and distributed via pipeline, rail, truck, barge, and vessel.

products.name: Low-Carbon Ammonia
products.description: Ammonia produced with reduced carbon intensity using carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) or autothermal reforming (ATR) with CCS, targeted at customers seeking to lower their carbon footprint for energy, fertilizer, and industrial uses. Requires significant investment in decarbonization infrastructure and compliance with regulatory standards.

products.name: Granular Urea
products.description: Solid nitrogen fertilizer produced by upgrading ammonia, manufactured at large-scale plants and distributed globally. Used primarily in agriculture for crop nutrition, requiring physical manufacturing and regulated handling.

products.name: Urea Ammonium Nitrate Solution (UAN)
products.description: Liquid nitrogen fertilizer produced by combining urea, ammonia, and nitric acid, manufactured at dedicated plants and distributed via truck, rail, and barge. Used primarily in agriculture for crop fertilization.

products.name: Ammonium Nitrate (AN)
products.description: Solid nitrogen product produced by reacting ammonia with nitric acid, used as fertilizer and as a component in commercial explosives. Manufactured at regulated facilities and distributed to agricultural and industrial customers.

products.name: Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)
products.description: A urea-based solution produced from ammonia and urea, used to reduce nitrogen oxide emissions in diesel engines. Manufactured at chemical plants and distributed to industrial customers.

products.name: Urea Liquor
products.description: A liquid form of urea produced at chemical plants, used in industrial processes and as a feedstock for other products. Requires specialized storage and handling.

products.name: Nitric Acid
products.description: A commodity chemical produced by oxidizing ammonia, used in the manufacture of fertilizers, explosives, and other industrial products. Manufactured at dedicated plants and sold to industrial customers.

products.name: Aqua Ammonia
products.description: A solution of ammonia in water, produced at chemical plants and used in industrial applications such as emissions control and water treatment. Requires regulated handling and distribution.

products.name: Fasedienol (Intranasal Pherine for Social Anxiety Disorder)
products.description: A synthetic neuroactive intranasal pherine developed for the acute treatment of social anxiety disorder (SAD) in adults. Delivered via nasal spray, it is manufactured through organic synthesis and formulated for non-systemic, rapid-onset action targeting nasal chemosensory neurons. Clinical development and manufacturing are outsourced to contract organizations.

products.name: Itruvone (Intranasal Pherine for Major Depressive Disorder)
products.description: An investigational non-systemic, neurocircuitry-focused intranasal pherine for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD). Produced synthetically and administered via nasal spray, it is designed for rapid-onset antidepressant effects without systemic absorption. Manufacturing is outsourced to contract organizations.

products.name: PH80 (Intranasal Pherine for Vasomotor Symptoms and Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder)
products.description: A non-hormonal, non-systemic, neurocircuitry-focused intranasal pherine developed for the treatment of vasomotor symptoms (hot flashes) due to menopause and premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD). Manufactured synthetically and delivered via nasal spray, PH80 is designed for rapid, as-needed relief. Manufacturing is outsourced to contract organizations.

products.name: PH15 (Intranasal Pherine for Cognitive and Psychomotor Impairment due to Mental Fatigue)
products.description: An investigational intranasal pherine for improving cognitive and psychomotor impairment caused by mental fatigue. Produced synthetically and administered via nasal spray, PH15 targets nasal receptors to activate neural circuits associated with cognition and psychomotor activity. Manufacturing is outsourced to contract organizations.

products.name: PH284 (Intranasal Pherine for Cancer Cachexia and Appetite-Related Disorders)
products.description: An investigational intranasal pherine for the treatment of cancer cachexia and other appetite-related disorders. Manufactured synthetically and delivered via nasal spray, PH284 targets neural circuits involved in appetite control. Manufacturing is outsourced to contract organizations.

products.name: AV-101 (Oral Prodrug for NMDAR-Related Neurological Disorders)
products.description: A novel oral prodrug targeting the NMDAR (N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor) for potential treatment of neurological disorders such as levodopa-induced dyskinesia, neuropathic pain, and depression. Manufactured through organic synthesis and formulated for oral administration, with clinical and manufacturing activities outsourced to contract organizations.

products.name: RF and Microwave Amplifiers and Subsystems
products.description: Designs, engineers, and assembles connectorized and chip-based RF amplifiers (including low noise, medium power, and cryogenic amplifiers) and related subsystems for satellite, telecom, defense, quantum computing, and commercial applications. Products are manufactured in-house and delivered as physical components or subsystems.

products.name: Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits (MMICs) and Signal Processing Chips
products.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures MMIC chips including LNAs, power amplifiers, filters, attenuators, and custom signal processing components for high-frequency communications, satellite, 5G, defense, and commercial markets. Delivered as semiconductor chips for integration into customer systems.

products.name: Passive Microwave Components and Subsystems
products.description: Designs and manufactures passive microwave components such as waveguides, adapters, couplers, power dividers, hybrid couplers, and switch panels for SATCOM, military, and commercial applications. Products are manufactured and delivered as physical components or subsystems.

products.name: Integrated Circuit (IC) Packaging and Lids Distribution
products.description: Distributes IC packaging and lids for semiconductor device assembly, prototyping, testing, and production, including ceramic semiconductor packages. Products are sourced from third parties and distributed globally to semiconductor manufacturers and OEMs.

products.name: Open RAN (ORAN) 5G Radio Units and Networks
products.description: Develops and manufactures O-RAN compliant 5G radio units (RUs), distributed units (DUs), centralized units (CUs), and full ORAN radio networks, including Massive MIMO and private 5G solutions. Products are delivered as hardware and integrated systems for telecom operators and enterprise networks.

products.name: 5G Network in a Box (NIB) Solutions
products.description: Provides turnkey, plug-and-play 5G network-in-a-box solutions for rapid deployment of private and local carrier networks, integrating proprietary radio units and amplifiers. Delivered as integrated hardware systems for enterprise and carrier customers.

products.name: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) and Custom Design Services
products.description: Offers project-based engineering and custom design services for RF, microwave, and MMIC components and subsystems, delivered on a fixed contract or time and materials basis. Services are provided to customers in aerospace, defense, and commercial sectors.

products.name: Gene Therapies for Inherited Retinal Diseases (IRDs)
products.description: A portfolio of adeno-associated virus (AAV)-based gene therapies designed as one-time, durable treatments to address the underlying genetic causes of severe inherited retinal disorders, including LCA5, BEST1, RHO, CNGB1, RDH12, NMNAT1, and MERTK mutations. These therapies are physically manufactured biologic products administered via subretinal injection in clinical settings.

products.name: Phentolamine Ophthalmic Solution 0.75% (PS)
products.description: A small-molecule, preservative-free ophthalmic solution (eye drop) developed and manufactured for multiple vision conditions, including reversal of pharmacologically induced mydriasis (RYZUMVI®), presbyopia (VEGA program), and decreased vision under dim light conditions after keratorefractive surgery (LYNX program). Delivered as a sterile, once-daily topical eye drop, with commercial manufacturing and distribution partnerships.

products.name: APX3330 (Ref-1 Inhibitor Therapy)
products.description: A selective small-molecule oral therapy targeting the Ref-1 protein to inhibit redox signaling and angiogenesis, developed for the treatment of diabetic retinopathy and diabetic macular edema. Manufactured as a solid oral tablet using conventional chemical processes, with clinical trials conducted for ophthalmic indications.

products.name: Pure Electric Off-Road Vehicles
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells pure electric off-road vehicles such as utility vehicles (UTVs), all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), golf carts, and go-karts. These are physically manufactured products delivered through direct and indirect sales channels, primarily targeting the U.S. and China markets.

products.name: Electric Scooters and Self-Balancing Scooters
products.description: Manufactures and sells electric scooters and electric self-balancing scooters, including associated parts. These are physical products distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Electric Vehicle Parts
products.description: Produces and sells electric vehicle (EV) parts, which are components used in the assembly or repair of electric vehicles. These are manufactured goods supplied to external customers.

products.name: Electric Vehicles (EV Products)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells complete electric vehicles (EVs), including models such as the K23, primarily for the China market. These are fully assembled vehicles delivered to customers via direct sales.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Cells
products.description: Manufactures and sells lithium-ion cells, which are battery components used in electric vehicles and other applications. These are produced in-house and sold to external customers.

products.name: Battery Exchange Equipment and Services
products.description: Provides battery exchange equipment and related battery exchange services, enabling customers to swap depleted batteries for charged ones. This includes both the physical infrastructure and the operational service.

products.name: Commission Income
products.description: Earns commission income from facilitating sales or distribution of products, likely as an ancillary service to core product lines. This is a service-based revenue stream.

products.name: Recycled Polyester and Nylon Fiber Products (REPREVE)
products.description: Manufactured recycled polyester and nylon fibers, including staple fiber and filament yarns, produced from pre- and post-consumer waste (such as plastic bottles) using advanced recycling and fiber extrusion processes. Delivered globally to yarn manufacturers, knitters, and weavers for use in apparel, furnishings, automotive, industrial, and other markets.

products.name: Virgin Polyester and Nylon Yarn Products
products.description: Manufactured virgin (non-recycled) polyester and nylon yarns, including partially oriented yarn (POY), textured, dyed, twisted, beamed, and draw wound yarns, produced through polymerization and spinning processes. Sold to textile manufacturers for use in apparel, home furnishings, automotive, industrial, and other end-use markets.

products.name: Specialty and Value-Added Performance Yarns
products.description: Engineered yarns with enhanced performance characteristics such as water repellency, flame retardation, soil release, color-fastness, and UV protection, produced by incorporating proprietary technologies and additives during manufacturing. Delivered to customers seeking differentiated textile solutions for various end markets.

products.name: Polyester Polymer Beads (Chip)
products.description: Manufactured polyester resin beads (Chip), both recycled (REPREVE Chip) and virgin, produced via polymerization and sold as raw material to external customers for further fiber or plastic production. Produced at dedicated facilities and sold to third parties in the textile and plastics industries.

products.name: Plastic Bottle Flake (Flake)
products.description: Processed PET plastic bottle flake produced from collected post-consumer bottles at UNIFI’s bottle processing facility, sold as a recycled raw material to external customers for use in fiber, nonwovens, carpet, and packaging applications.

products.name: Textile Takeback and Thermaloop Insulation Products
products.description: Newly introduced products based on textile recycling (Textile Takeback platform) and fiber-based insulation (Thermaloop), leveraging advanced recycling and fiber processing technologies. Delivered to customers seeking sustainable textile and insulation solutions.

products.name: SAB-142 (Human Anti-Thymocyte Globulin Immunotherapy)
products.description: A multi-specific, fully human anti-thymocyte globulin (hATG) immunotherapy produced using genetically engineered transchromosomic cattle (Tc Bovine) to generate high-potency, human immunoglobulin G (hIgG) for the treatment and prevention of autoimmune disorders, initially targeting type 1 diabetes (T1D). The product is manufactured via plasma collection from hyperimmunized Tc Bovine, followed by plasma fractionation and purification.

products.name: Human Polyclonal Immunoglobulin G (hIgG) Therapeutics for Autoimmune and Immune Disorders
products.description: Therapeutic candidates consisting of targeted, high-potency, fully human polyclonal immunoglobulin G (hIgG) antibodies produced in Tc Bovine for the treatment and prevention of a broad range of immune and autoimmune disorders beyond T1D. These are developed using the same proprietary platform and manufacturing process as SAB-142, with disease-specific immunogens to generate targeted hIgG.

products.name: Human Polyclonal Immunoglobulin G (hIgG) Therapeutics for Infectious Diseases and Toxins
products.description: Fully human polyclonal hIgG antibodies produced in Tc Bovine, targeted against infectious agents (such as viruses, bacteria, and toxins), developed using the proprietary platform. These therapeutics are manufactured by immunizing Tc Bovine with disease-specific immunogens, collecting plasma, and purifying hIgG for use as immunotherapy or prophylaxis against infectious diseases.

products.name: TAO Staking and Yield Generation
products.description: The company accumulates and stakes TAO, the native cryptocurrency of the Bittensor network, to generate yield in the form of additional TAO tokens. This is a digital asset investment activity, requiring financial capital and digital asset management, and is delivered through blockchain-based staking mechanisms.

products.name: Mezzanine™ Visual Collaboration Systems
products.description: Mezzanine™ is a family of turn-key hardware and software products enabling immersive, multi-user, multi-screen visual collaboration for in-room and virtual meetings. Delivered as configurable systems with proprietary technology, it requires physical manufacturing, integration, and ongoing support.

products.name: Managed Services for Video Collaboration
products.description: The company provides managed services for video collaboration, including setup, management, and 24/7 remote support of customer videoconferencing environments. Services are delivered via a hybrid service platform or as a service layer on top of customer infrastructure, requiring in-person and remote human labor.

products.name: Managed Network Services
products.description: The company offers managed network solutions to ensure reliable, high-quality, and secure video, data, and internet traffic for customers. These services are provided on a subscription basis and involve purchasing and reselling connectivity, requiring regulated infrastructure and ongoing management.

products.name: Private Education Loans
products.description: Origination and servicing of private student loans for undergraduate and graduate students and their families, including specialized loans for law, MBA, health professions, medical, dental, bar study, residency, relocation, and airline career programs. Loans are underwritten, disbursed directly to educational institutions, and serviced in-house.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provision of FDIC-insured deposit products including high-yield savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit (CDs) to retail customers, delivered through Sallie Mae Bank's digital banking platform.

products.name: Loan Servicing and Program Management Services
products.description: Servicing and program management of private education loans, including those originated and sold through strategic partnerships, with ongoing fee-based revenue for servicing, customer relationship management, and industry expertise. Services are delivered via proprietary digital platforms and dedicated representatives.

products.name: College Planning Tools and Scholarship Search Services
products.description: Provision of free digital tools, resources, and platforms to assist students and families with college planning, scholarship search, and financial literacy, including services formerly branded as Nitro and Scholly, now integrated into Sallie Mae's offerings.
